title: Why fine-tune when you can use AGI?

cues.en: I'm pretty sure that if you are watching this video, you regularly use some state of the art chatbot
cues.zh: 我很確定，觀看這支影片的你，平常會使用某些最先進的聊天機器人，

cues.en: like ChatGPT or Deep SEQ or Claude from anthropic or whatever other model.
cues.zh: 例如 ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Anthropic 的 Claude，或其他模型。

cues.en: So you might be wondering why anyone would want to fine tune their own model based on publicly available
cues.zh: 所以你可能想，既然最新 ChatGPT 模型更大、更強，

cues.en: base models when the latest model of ChatGPT is much bigger and more powerful?
cues.zh: 為什麼還要用公開的基礎模型，自己微調？

cues.en: That's a fair question, and it is certainly not the case that fine tuning is always economically or practically the right decision.
cues.zh: 這是合理問題，而且微調並非在經濟或實務上永遠都是正確決定。

cues.en: By the way, AGI stands for artificial general intelligence.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，AGI 是 artificial general intelligence，通用人工智慧。

cues.en: It's the idea that one model can be better that than almost any human at almost any task, at least language based task.
cues.zh: 概念是同一個模型，在幾乎任何任務，至少語言任務上，都能勝過幾乎所有人。

cues.en: Whether we already have AGI depends on how you define it and how you want to quantify it.
cues.zh: 我們是否已經有 AGI，取決於如何定義與量化。

cues.en: But let's just focus on state of the art models.
cues.zh: 不過，先聚焦最先進的模型。

cues.en: That's what this stands for.
cues.zh: 這個縮寫就是這個意思。

cues.en: State of the art models.
cues.zh: 最先進的模型。

cues.en: Now, even if you don't think that AGI is already a reality, it certainly is the case that modern commercial
cues.zh: 即使你認為 AGI 還沒成真，現代商用模型

cues.en: are very good at many language based tasks, and they interface with models that are very good at image generation.
cues.zh: 確實已很擅長許多語言任務，也能介接很擅長生圖的模型。

cues.en: Certainly these state of the art models are not perfect.
cues.zh: 當然，這些最先進模型並不完美。

cues.en: They're not always perfectly accurate, but they are generally quite good.
cues.zh: 不見得永遠準確，但整體表現相當不錯。

cues.en: That is not intrinsic to the nature of coding or art or social media marketing strategies.
cues.zh: 這並不是寫程式、藝術，或社群行銷策略本身具有的內在特性。

cues.en: Quite the opposite.
cues.zh: 正好相反。

cues.en: The big developing companies that have the most powerful models, because they have the most powerful compute power, are profit driven.
cues.zh: 大型開發公司擁有最強的運算能力，因此能打造最強模型，而這些公司由獲利驅動。

cues.en: And so they push their models to be great at whatever they deem to be the most commercially profitable.
cues.zh: 所以，他們會讓模型擅長自己認為商業收益最高的事情。

cues.en: You know, Microsoft is not going to spend $100 million developing an AI that's really great at distinguishing
cues.zh: 你知道，微軟不會花一億美元，開發特別擅長分辨

cues.en: between different bird calls in the Sahara Desert, because there's just no large scale commercial viability for that kind of expertise.
cues.zh: 撒哈拉沙漠各種鳥叫聲的 AI，因為這類專業沒有大規模商業可行性。

cues.en: On the other hand, an AI that can either greatly assist or even replace entry level and mid-level coders
cues.zh: 但如果 AI 能大幅協助，甚至取代初階與中階程式設計師，

cues.en: and marketing strategists, now that has huge commercial potential.
cues.zh: 以及行銷策略人員，就有龐大的商業潛力。

cues.en: Of course, there are also really significant societal and economic and cultural implications of that.
cues.zh: 當然，這也會帶來重大的社會、經濟與文化影響。

cues.en: But my point here is that you might be able to build a customized LL that is better than ChatGPT at
cues.zh: 我想說的是，如果某個狹窄任務不是 OpenAI 真正關注的，

cues.en: some narrow task if it's one that OpenAI is just not really focusing on.
cues.zh: 你可能可以建立一個比 ChatGPT 更擅長該任務的客製 LLM。

cues.en: So that is one point to consider.
cues.zh: 這是一個考量。

cues.en: Furthermore, the models, like the latest GPT, are controlled by companies.
cues.zh: 另外，像最新 GPT 這些模型，是由公司控制。

cues.en: Their weights are secured on their servers and you cannot access them.
cues.zh: 權重保存在他們的伺服器，無法存取。

cues.en: Of course, you can push data into a forward pass and get the output, but you cannot just download the latest GPT model and start tinkering with the weights.
cues.zh: 當然，可以傳資料做前向傳播、取得輸出，但不能直接下載最新 GPT，自己改權重。

cues.en: And that means that you are limited by the decisions made by companies like OpenAI, Microsoft, Facebook and so on.
cues.zh: 這表示你受限於 OpenAI、微軟、Facebook 等公司的決策。

cues.en: So having your own model to fine tune gives you full control over what you do with that model.
cues.zh: 所以，有自己的模型來微調，就能完全掌控如何使用。

cues.en: On the other hand, I think you can now appreciate how tricky fine tuning models can be.
cues.zh: 另一方面，現在你應該也能體會，微調模型有多棘手。

cues.en: So if you need to access a model to help you with some data or a classification task.
cues.zh: 如果只需要模型幫忙處理某些資料或分類任務，

cues.en: Let's say you need to do it only occasionally.
cues.zh: 而且只是偶爾需要，

cues.en: Then it might be better just to use ChatGPT.
cues.zh: 那也許直接用 ChatGPT 比較好。

cues.en: Uh, yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: This point I already mentioned.
cues.zh: 這點之前提過。

cues.en: If you develop your own model, then you can continue fine tuning it, tweaking it, reusing it, trying to package it into an app to sell or to give away for free.
cues.zh: 開發自己的模型，就能繼續微調、調整、重複使用，試著包裝成應用程式，販售或免費提供。

cues.en: You can do whatever you want with your own model.
cues.zh: 自己的模型，想怎麼用都可以。

cues.en: Relatedly, these state of the art llms are designed to be general purpose models.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這些最先進 LLM 是設計成通用模型。

cues.en: They are generally good at almost any language based task, but that doesn't mean that they are really great at any one thing that you might need.
cues.zh: 整體上擅長幾乎各種語言任務，但不代表特別擅長你需要的某一件事。

cues.en: For example, they may not have been trained on some very specific application that you are looking for, or the company that hires you to develop a targeted is looking for.
cues.zh: 例如，它可能沒針對你所需，或聘你開發特定用途模型的公司所需之特殊應用訓練。

cues.en: In other words, just because those models are bigger doesn't mean they're necessarily better.
cues.zh: 換句話說，模型比較大，不代表一定比較好。

cues.en: And there are also practical considerations.
cues.zh: 也有實務考量。

cues.en: Even if you had all the weights from the latest OpenAI GPT model.
cues.zh: 即使擁有最新 OpenAI GPT 的全部權重，

cues.en: Those huge models are so incredibly big that they just take up a lot of space, and they take a really long time to do a forward pass on.
cues.zh: 這些巨型模型也非常占空間，前向傳播耗時很長。

cues.en: Not to mention backprop.
cues.zh: 更不用說反向傳播。

cues.en: So even on a moderately powerful GPU that is commercially available, it's still going to be really
cues.zh: 所以，即使用市售、效能中上等級的 GPU，

cues.en: hard to practically use a ginormous state of the art language model.
cues.zh: 要實際使用極龐大的最先進語言模型，仍然很困難。

cues.en: So therefore, using your own custom fine tuned model can not only give you better results for some
cues.zh: 因此，用自己客製微調的模型，不只能對特定

cues.en: narrow application, but can also be faster and more lightweight.
cues.zh: 應用得到更好結果，也可能更快、更輕量。

cues.en: That can be really important.
cues.zh: 這可以非常重要。

cues.en: For example, if you want to put an LM on a phone, it's just not feasible to have a 100 billion parameter
cues.zh: 例如，想把 LLM 放進手機，就不可能指望一個一千億參數的

cues.en: model sitting on someone's phone and expect it to run in real time.
cues.zh: 模型，直接放在別人的手機上還能即時執行。

cues.en: And this term here, in-context learning refers to teaching a model a new task without fine tuning it to do that task.
cues.zh: 這裡的 in-context learning，語境學習，是指不用微調，就教會模型新任務。

cues.en: Basically, you would give ChatGPT a few examples of a new task, and then it can learn how to perform
cues.zh: 基本上，給 ChatGPT 幾個新任務的範例，就能學習如何執行

cues.en: and generalize that new task, even without any additional fine tuning of the weights.
cues.zh: 與泛化到該新任務，即使權重完全沒有額外微調。

cues.en: I'll have more to say about In-context learning later in the section on AI safety.
cues.zh: AI 安全章節會再談語境學習。

cues.en: Take home points here.
cues.zh: 這裡的重點是，

cues.en: The state of the art models are great, but there are many situations where you can get better accuracy,
cues.zh: 最先進模型很棒，但很多情境下，自己開發模型，能得到更高準確率、

cues.en: more control and ownership, and faster responses by developing your own models.
cues.zh: 更多控制與所有權，以及更快的回應。
